name: Eleanor Davies
bio:
Eleanor Davies has been perfecting her craft in motorsport paint shops for over two decades. Starting as an apprentice straight out of school, she quickly developed a keen eye for detail and a passion for achieving flawless finishes. Eleanor honed her skills at various racing outfits before finding a long-term home at GCK Motorsport. 

Known for her meticulous approach, Eleanor is unwavering in her pursuit of excellence. She's a stickler for process and believes that preparation is the key to a perfect paint job. Eleanor is always experimenting with new techniques and materials, though she is slow to adopt them until they've proven results. Her work isn't just about aesthetics; it's about contributing to the team's performance by ensuring the cars are aerodynamically optimized and visually impactful. Eleanor's dedication makes her a valuable asset to GCK Motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Eleanor is a woman of medium height with a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky overalls, despite their faded appearance.
Insists on listening to classical music while working to maintain focus.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets displayed on her workbench.
